The unmodified API headers in this directory are from AMD FidelityFX SDK 2.4.0,
commit `7539ae8b6568ad29ed78a753404351daf3b5cca7`:
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK

The headers retain their MIT copyright and permission notices. Paths below
`api/` and `upscalers/` match the upstream `Kits/FidelityFX/` tree.
No binary library is included. The optional Windows experiment dynamically
loads the official `amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll` and
`amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll` from the executable directory.
